CornerSlide.Tableau : (Nat → Nat → Prop) → List Nat → CornerSlide.Rows → Prop
CornerSlide.NoThreeChain : (Nat → Nat → Prop) → Prop
CornerSlide.demote_valid_iff : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  (∀ (x y : Nat), r x y → ¬r y x) →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (front : CornerSlide.Rows) (c d : Nat) (tail : List Nat),
      CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.before front c d tail) →
        (CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.after front c d tail) ↔ CornerSlide.Boundary r d tail)
CornerSlide.flatten_before_after : ∀ (front : CornerSlide.Rows) (c d : Nat) (tail : List Nat),
  List.flatten (CornerSlide.before front c d tail) = List.flatten (CornerSlide.after front c d tail)
CornerSlide.tableau_graph_inversions_eq_word : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r]
  (rows : CornerSlide.Rows),
  (∀ (row : List Nat), row ∈ rows → List.Pairwise r row) →
    CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r rows = CornerSlide.graphInversions r (List.flatten rows)
CornerSlide.bubble_tableau_valid : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  (∀ (x y : Nat), r x y → ¬r y x) →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (front : CornerSlide.Rows) (c d : Nat) (tail : List Nat),
      CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.before front c d tail) →
        CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.bubbleAfter r front c d tail)
CornerSlide.bubble_tableau_graph_inversions : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  (∀ (x y : Nat), r x y → ¬r y x) →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (front : CornerSlide.Rows) (c d : Nat) (tail : List Nat),
      CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.before front c d tail) →
        CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r (CornerSlide.bubbleAfter r front c d tail) =
          CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r (CornerSlide.before front c d tail)
CornerSlide.extract_bubble_inverse_height_two : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (a b : Nat) (tail : List Nat),
      r a b → CornerSlide.extractFirst (r a) (CornerSlide.bubbleInsert r b tail) = some (b, tail)
CornerSlide.bubble_tableau_injective : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (front front' : CornerSlide.Rows) (c d c' d' : Nat) (tail tail' : List Nat),
      List.length front = List.length front' →
        CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.before front c d tail) →
          CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices (CornerSlide.before front' c' d' tail') →
            CornerSlide.bubbleAfter r front c d tail = CornerSlide.bubbleAfter r front' c' d' tail' →
              front = front' ∧ c = c' ∧ d = d' ∧ tail = tail'
CornerSlide.mem_family : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (vertices shape : List Nat) (rows : CornerSlide.Rows),
  rows ∈ CornerSlide.family r vertices shape ↔ CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices rows ∧ List.map List.length rows = shape
CornerSlide.family_nodup : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (vertices shape : List Nat),
  (CornerSlide.family r vertices shape).Nodup
CornerSlide.bubbleAt_family : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  (∀ (x y : Nat), r x y → ¬r y x) →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (k m : Nat) (rows : CornerSlide.Rows),
      rows ∈ CornerSlide.family r vertices (CornerSlide.twoColumnShape (k + 1) m) →
        CornerSlide.bubbleAt r k rows ∈ CornerSlide.family r vertices (CornerSlide.twoColumnShape k (m + 2))
CornerSlide.bubbleAt_family_injective : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (k m : Nat) (rows rows' : CornerSlide.Rows),
      rows ∈ CornerSlide.family r vertices (CornerSlide.twoColumnShape (k + 1) m) →
        rows' ∈ CornerSlide.family r vertices (CornerSlide.twoColumnShape (k + 1) m) →
          CornerSlide.bubbleAt r k rows = CornerSlide.bubbleAt r k rows' → rows = rows'
CornerSlide.bubbleAt_family_weight : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  (∀ (x y : Nat), r x y → ¬r y x) →
    ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (k m : Nat) (rows : CornerSlide.Rows),
      rows ∈ CornerSlide.family r vertices (CornerSlide.twoColumnShape (k + 1) m) →
        CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r (CornerSlide.bubbleAt r k rows) = CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r rows
@CornerSlide.degreeCount : {α : Type} → (α → Nat) → Nat → List α → Nat
@CornerSlide.degreewise_cancellation : ∀ {α β : Type} [inst : BEq β] [inst_1 : LawfulBEq β] (source : List α)
  (target : List β) (f : α → β) (sourceWeight : α → Nat) (targetWeight : β → Nat),
  source.Nodup →
    target.Nodup →
      (∀ (x : α), x ∈ source → f x ∈ target) →
        (∀ (x : α), x ∈ source → ∀ (y : α), y ∈ source → f x = f y → x = y) →
          (∀ (x : α), x ∈ source → targetWeight (f x) = sourceWeight x) →
            ∀ (degree : Nat),
              CornerSlide.degreeCount targetWeight degree target =
                CornerSlide.degreeCount sourceWeight degree source +
                  CornerSlide.degreeCount targetWeight degree
                    (List.filter (fun y => decide ¬y ∈ List.map f source) target)
CornerSlide.columnFamily : (Nat → Nat → Prop) → List Nat → Nat → List CornerSlide.Rows
CornerSlide.mem_columnFamily : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (vertices : List Nat) (k : Nat) (rows : CornerSlide.Rows),
  rows ∈ CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices k ↔
    2 * k ≤ vertices.length ∧
      CornerSlide.Tableau r vertices rows ∧
        List.map List.length rows = CornerSlide.twoColumnShape k (vertices.length - 2 * k)
CornerSlide.survivorFamily : (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) → [DecidableRel r] → List Nat → Nat → List CornerSlide.Rows
CornerSlide.mem_survivorFamily : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r] (vertices : List Nat) (k : Nat)
  (rows : CornerSlide.Rows),
  rows ∈ CornerSlide.survivorFamily r vertices k ↔
    rows ∈ CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices k ∧
      ¬rows ∈ List.map (CornerSlide.bubbleAt r k) (CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices (k + 1))
CornerSlide.height_two_degreewise_cancellation : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r],
  (∀ (x y : Nat), r x y → ¬r y x) →
    CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
      ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (k degree : Nat),
        CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree (CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices k) =
          CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree
              (CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices (k + 1)) +
            CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree
              (CornerSlide.survivorFamily r vertices k)
CornerSlide.finiteRelation : List Nat → (Nat → Nat → Prop) → Nat → Nat → Prop
CornerSlide.finite_height_two_degreewise_cancellation : ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (base : Nat → Nat → Prop)
  [inst : DecidableRel base],
  (∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ vertices → ∀ (y : Nat), y ∈ vertices → base x y → ¬base y x) →
    (∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ vertices → ∀ (y : Nat), y ∈ vertices → ∀ (z : Nat), z ∈ vertices → base x y → base y z → False) →
      ∀ (k degree : Nat),
        let r := CornerSlide.finiteRelation vertices base;
        CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree (CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices k) =
          CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree
              (CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices (k + 1)) +
            CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree
              (CornerSlide.survivorFamily r vertices k)
CornerSlide.empty_vertex_degree_count : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r] (degree : Nat),
  CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree (CornerSlide.columnFamily r [] 0) =
    if degree = 0 then 1 else 0
CornerSlide.single_vertex_degree_count : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r] (x degree : Nat),
  CornerSlide.degreeCount (CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r) degree (CornerSlide.columnFamily r [x] 0) =
    if degree = 0 then 1 else 0
CornerSlide.survivorFamily_empty_source : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r] (vertices : List Nat)
  (k : Nat),
  vertices.length < 2 * (k + 1) → CornerSlide.survivorFamily r vertices k = CornerSlide.columnFamily r vertices k
SignedArrays.ChainArray : (Nat → Nat → Prop) → List Nat → SignedArrays.Array → Prop
SignedArrays.SignedArray : (Nat → Nat → Prop) → List Nat → (Nat → Nat) → SignedArrays.Array → Prop
SignedArrays.Partition : (Nat → Nat) → Prop
SignedArrays.PaddedTableau : (Nat → Nat → Prop) → List Nat → CornerSlide.Rows → Prop
SignedArrays.permutationSign : List Nat → Int
SignedArrays.shiftKey_injective : ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
  SignedArrays.Partition lambda → ∀ (p q : Nat), SignedArrays.shiftKey lambda p = SignedArrays.shiftKey lambda q → p = q
SignedArrays.adjacent_length_exclusion : ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
  SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
    ∀ (i : Int) (p q : Nat) (upper lower : List Nat) (tail : SignedArrays.Array),
      p ≠ q → SignedArrays.ShapeAt lambda i ((p, upper) :: (q, lower) :: tail) → ↑lower.length ≠ ↑upper.length + 1
SignedArrays.height_two_row_length_le_two : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r → ∀ (row : List Nat), List.Pairwise r row → row.length ≤ 2
SignedArrays.togglePair_involution : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (x y : SignedArrays.Entry),
  SignedArrays.togglePair r (SignedArrays.togglePair r x y).fst (SignedArrays.togglePair r x y).snd = (x, y)
SignedArrays.bottommost_pivot_stable : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (x y : SignedArrays.Entry) (tail : SignedArrays.Array),
  SignedArrays.Good r (y :: tail) → SignedArrays.Good r ((SignedArrays.togglePair r x y).snd :: tail)
SignedArrays.move_involution : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
  SignedArrays.move r (SignedArrays.move r a) = a
SignedArrays.move_signedArray : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (vertices : List Nat) (lambda : Nat → Nat)
  (a : SignedArrays.Array),
  SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda a → SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda (SignedArrays.move r a)
SignedArrays.move_tableauGraphInversions : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) [inst : DecidableRel r] (vertices : List Nat)
  (a : SignedArrays.Array),
  SignedArrays.ChainArray r vertices a →
    CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r (SignedArrays.rows (SignedArrays.move r a)) =
      CornerSlide.tableauGraphInversions r (SignedArrays.rows a)
SignedArrays.move_fixed_iff_good : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (i : Int) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          (SignedArrays.labels a).Nodup →
            SignedArrays.ShapeAt lambda i a →
              (∀ (entry : SignedArrays.Entry), entry ∈ a → List.Pairwise r entry.snd) →
                (SignedArrays.move r a = a ↔ SignedArrays.Good r a)
SignedArrays.columns_iff_good : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (i : Int) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          (SignedArrays.labels a).Nodup →
            SignedArrays.ShapeAt lambda i a →
              (∀ (entry : SignedArrays.Entry), entry ∈ a → List.Pairwise r entry.snd) →
                (CornerSlide.ColumnsValid r (SignedArrays.rows a) ↔ SignedArrays.Good r a)
SignedArrays.signedArray_fixed_iff_padded : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda a →
            (SignedArrays.move r a = a ↔ SignedArrays.PaddedTableau r vertices (SignedArrays.rows a))
SignedArrays.fixed_labels_identity : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda a →
            SignedArrays.move r a = a → SignedArrays.labels a = List.range (List.length a)
SignedArrays.fixed_row_lengths : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda a →
            SignedArrays.move r a = a →
              List.map List.length (SignedArrays.rows a) = List.map lambda (List.range (List.length a))
SignedArrays.move_sign_reversing : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
  (SignedArrays.labels a).Nodup →
    SignedArrays.move r a ≠ a →
      SignedArrays.permutationSign (SignedArrays.labels (SignedArrays.move r a)) =
        -SignedArrays.permutationSign (SignedArrays.labels a)
SignedArrays.signedArray_bad_sign_reversing : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda a →
            ¬SignedArrays.Good r a →
              SignedArrays.permutationSign (SignedArrays.labels (SignedArrays.move r a)) =
                -SignedArrays.permutationSign (SignedArrays.labels a)
SignedArrays.fixed_permutationSign : ∀ (r : Nat → Nat → Prop),
  CornerSlide.NoThreeChain r →
    ∀ (lambda : Nat → Nat),
      SignedArrays.Partition lambda →
        ∀ (vertices : List Nat) (a : SignedArrays.Array),
          SignedArrays.SignedArray r vertices lambda a →
            SignedArrays.move r a = a → SignedArrays.permutationSign (SignedArrays.labels a) = 1
AlternantSubsets.NoRise : List Bool → Prop
AlternantSubsets.ones : List Bool → Nat
AlternantSubsets.exponent : Nat → Nat → Nat → Bool → Int
AlternantSubsets.candidate : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → List Bool
AlternantSubsets.noRise_iff_prefix : ∀ (xs : List Bool),
  AlternantSubsets.NoRise xs ↔
    xs = List.replicate (AlternantSubsets.ones xs) true ++ List.replicate (xs.length - AlternantSubsets.ones xs) false
AlternantSubsets.adjacent_exponent_collision : ∀ (m a i : Nat) (x y : Bool),
  AlternantSubsets.exponent m a i x = AlternantSubsets.exponent m a (i + 1) y ↔ i + 1 ≠ a ∧ x = false ∧ y = true
AlternantSubsets.adjacent_exponent_weakly_decreasing : ∀ (m a i : Nat) (x y : Bool),
  AlternantSubsets.exponent m a (i + 1) y ≤ AlternantSubsets.exponent m a i x
AlternantSubsets.candidate_length : ∀ (m a b j : Nat),
  b ≤ a → a + b ≤ m → j ≤ b → (AlternantSubsets.candidate m a b j).length = m
AlternantSubsets.candidate_ones : ∀ (m a b j : Nat),
  j ≤ b → AlternantSubsets.ones (AlternantSubsets.candidate m a b j) = b
AlternantSubsets.candidate_injective : ∀ (m a b j k : Nat),
  j ≤ a → k ≤ a → AlternantSubsets.candidate m a b j = AlternantSubsets.candidate m a b k → j = k
AlternantSubsets.two_block_classification : ∀ (m a b : Nat),
  b ≤ a →
    a + b ≤ m →
      ∀ (xs : List Bool),
        xs.length = m →
          AlternantSubsets.ones xs = b →
            (AlternantSubsets.NoRise (List.take a xs) ∧ AlternantSubsets.NoRise (List.drop a xs) ↔
              ∃ j,
                (j ≤ b ∧ xs = AlternantSubsets.candidate m a b j) ∧
                  ∀ (k : Nat), k ≤ b ∧ xs = AlternantSubsets.candidate m a b k → k = j)
